SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT LEGACY_GR_NO,LEGACY_GR_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM KEP_GR01 WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY LEGACY_GR_NO,LEGACY_GR_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KA' AS SITE, 'PTEC' AS BUYER, NVL(COMPANY_CODE,' ') AS PLANT, NVL(STATUS,' ') AS STATUS, NVL(LEGACY_PO_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(LEGACY_PO_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(CURRENCY_CODE,' ') AS CURRENCY_CODE, NVL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, NVL(UNIT_PRICE_UNIT,0) AS UNIT_PRICE_UNIT, NVL(GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, NVL(GR_AMT,0) AS GR_AMT, NVL(REPLACE(GR_DATE,'-',''),' ') AS GR_DATE, NVL(LEGACY_GR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_NO, NVL(LEGACY_GR_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, NVL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, NVL(BIGO,' ') AS REMARK, NVL(LAST_UDATE,' ') AS LAST_UPDATE, NVL(LAST_UTIME,' ') AS LAST_TIME FROM KEP_GR01 WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' ORDER BY LEGACY_GR_NO,LEGACY_GR_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE KEP_GR01 SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$'
